name: Tau Info
description: Reports Tau desktop app and venue information: app name and version, the venue name and DID, the store and process this instance holds and when it started, and the default skills Tau ships. Useful for diagnostics and to confirm the app is running against this venue.

version.description: Application version, or 'dev' when run from a build

skills.description: Tau's default skills, seeded under v/skills/brightside

store.description: The venue store this instance holds: a file path, or 'temp'

pid.description: The operating-system process id of this instance

started.description: When this instance's process started (ISO-8601), so a caller can see that a relaunch happened
